evidence.title: Retain the exact authorized Work Queue page when selecting its Incident or Task
evidence.goal: Fix a reproducible Case/Task selection regression: a row selected beyond page one must keep its current authorized cursor, while manual filter/sort changes start a new first-page query.
outputs: A selection on page 2/3 returns same currently authorized page and selected source row via existing route.
Manual changed status/sort/view never accidentally inherits stale page cursor.
Expired/revoked cursor and off-page IDs continue to return generic deny.
acceptance_tests: Build a 123-row fully authorized fixture: choose a row on page 3 via its native browser form, verify exact selected row/page and preserved view/status/sort.
Changing manual filters or sort from page 3 makes a fresh first-page request, not a stale cursor.
After ACL revocation prior page selection denies; forged off-page or stale cursor denies without source content.
Existing browser XSS and six-views tests plus Linux/macOS/Windows and mandatory >=90% changed critical security coverage green on exact HEAD.
